projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard project delivering three core capabilities: (1) data processing pipelines that ingest and normalize customer CSV files, (2) log analysis over application logs to surface operational and usage insights, and (3) a visualization layer that turns both data sources into interactive dashboards for stakeholders.

Scope is organized into five milestones: project foundation & data contracts, CSV data processing pipeline, application log analysis pipeline, visualization components & dashboard UI, and integration/hardening/release. Each milestone is decomposed into tasks sized for execution within roughly one to three days, with no single task carrying complexity above 6/10 so that nothing is too large to execute or estimate reliably.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, logging, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Project Foundation & Data Contracts
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation every downstream milestone depends on: repository and tooling, schema definitions for customer CSV data and application log data, and a shared metric definition layer so the CSV pipeline and log pipeline produce comparable, dashboard-ready datasets. Exit criteria: repo runs locally with CI, both schemas are documented and versioned, and the metric catalog is signed off by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the ingestion and transformation pipeline for customer CSV files: file intake, schema validation and quarantine of bad rows, cleaning/normalization, and aggregation into the curated customer metrics tables consumed by the dashboard. Exit criteria: pipeline runs end-to-end on representative sample CSVs, data quality report produced per run, curated tables populated and queryable.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the log analysis pipeline: parse application log lines into structured events, extract error/usage signals, compute operational metrics (error rates, request latency, activity by feature), and store results in queryable aggregates for the dashboard. Exit criteria: parser handles all known log formats, metrics computed on a representative log sample match manual spot checks, aggregates are queryable by the visualization layer.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Design and build the visualization layer: reusable chart components, dashboard page layouts for customer analytics and operational log health, shared filters/date-range controls, and a query/API layer connecting the UI to the curated datasets. Exit criteria: both dashboard views render live data, filters drive all charts consistently, and components are covered by visual and unit tests.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Hardening & Release
tasks.details: Connect both pipelines to the dashboard in a scheduled, monitored deployment: orchestration/scheduling, observability and alerting, performance and load validation, security/access review, user documentation, and staged release. Exit criteria: dashboard refreshes on schedule with alerting on pipeline failure, load test passes target, docs published, and release approved by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Scaffold repository, CI pipeline, and local dev environment
tasks.details: Create the monorepo/project structure, dependency management, linting/formatting config, and a CI workflow that runs lint + tests on every push. Include a docker-compose (or equivalent) local stack for the database/query engine. Deliverable: a new developer can clone, run one setup command, and execute the test suite locally.

tasks.name: Define and version the customer CSV schema contract
tasks.details: Document expected customer CSV columns, data types, required vs optional fields, allowed value ranges, and encoding/format conventions. Produce a machine-readable schema file (e.g., JSON Schema or Pydantic model) plus a short written contract doc. Include a decision record for handling schema evolution and unknown extra columns.

tasks.name: Define application log event schema and assemble sample log corpus
tasks.details: Document the normalized structured event model (timestamp, level, service, request id, user id, message, latency, error code, etc.) and map each known raw log format to it. Collect a representative, sanitized sample log corpus covering normal traffic, errors, and edge cases for use in development and testing.

tasks.name: Build metric catalog and get KPI definitions signed off
tasks.details: Define each dashboard KPI with an unambiguous formula, source field mapping, grain (daily/weekly), and owner — e.g., active customers, customer growth, churn, error rate, p95 latency, feature usage. Review with stakeholders and record sign-off so pipelines and visualizations share one definition of truth.

tasks.name: Implement CSV file intake and ingestion job
tasks.details: Build the entry point that discovers new customer CSV files (local directory watch or object-storage polling), records file metadata and checksums, streams rows in chunks to handle large files, and writes raw rows into a landing table with load-batch ids for lineage. Include idempotent re-run behavior so the same file is not double-loaded.

tasks.name: CSV row validation and quarantine
tasks.details: Validate every landed row against the versioned CSV schema: type checks, required fields, allowed value sets, and range rules. Route invalid rows to a quarantine table with the specific failure reason, and emit per-file pass/fail counts. Add a configurable threshold that fails the batch when invalid rows exceed an agreed percentage.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning and normalization transforms
tasks.details: Standardize customer records: trim/case-normalize strings, parse and validate dates into a consistent timezone, coerce currency and numeric formats, normalize country/region and plan names to canonical codes, and de-duplicate customers by stable business key keeping the most recent record. Unit-test each transform against representative edge cases.

tasks.name: Build curated customer metrics aggregation tables
tasks.details: Using the signed-off metric catalog, aggregate cleaned customer data into daily-grain curated tables: active customers, new customers, churn, revenue/ARPU, and segment breakdowns by plan and region. Support incremental reprocessing of recent days and document the table grain and refresh semantics.

tasks.name: Generate per-run data quality report for CSV pipeline
tasks.details: Produce an automated summary per ingestion run: rows read, rows accepted, rows quarantined with top failure reasons, duplicate count, null-rate per critical column, and row-count drift vs the previous run. Persist the report and surface it in logs so operators can triage without querying tables by hand.

tasks.name: Implement multi-format log line parser
tasks.details: Write a parser that detects and handles each known application log format (plain text, JSON lines, and stack-trace continuations), extracting timestamp, level, service, message, and structured fields into the normalized event model. Handle malformed lines by capturing them in a parse-error bucket rather than dropping silently. Cover each format with unit tests.

tasks.name: Enrich structured log events with context attributes
tasks.details: Extract and normalize derived attributes from parsed events: request id correlation, user/customer id where present, endpoint or feature name, HTTP status class, duration in milliseconds, error code taxonomy, and environment. Where fields are absent, apply documented fallbacks rather than leaving ambiguous nulls.

tasks.name: Compute error, latency, and usage metrics
tasks.details: Aggregate enriched events into hourly and daily metrics: error count and error rate by service/endpoint, p50/p95/p99 request latency, request volume, unique active users, and feature usage counts. Implement percentile logic that remains accurate on sampled data and tag each metric with its definition from the metric catalog.

tasks.name: Create log aggregate storage layer and query interface
tasks.details: Define partitioned storage for log aggregates (by date and service) with indexes supporting dashboard filter patterns, and provide a small typed query functions module (e.g., get_error_rate, get_latency_percentiles, get_feature_usage) that the visualization layer will call instead of hand-written SQL.

tasks.name: Run historical log backfill and manual spot-check validation
tasks.details: Backfill a meaningful historical window from the sample/real log corpus, then manually verify a sample of computed metrics against hand-counted values from raw logs across all three metric families (error rate, latency, usage). Record discrepancies, fix parser/aggregation bugs, and document the verification results as the pipeline's accuracy baseline.

tasks.name: Build dashboard query API
tasks.details: Expose read-only HTTP endpoints for each chart's data need: customer metric series, breakdown by plan/region, log error-rate series, latency percentiles, and feature usage. Standardize request params (date range, segment, granularity), response envelopes, error handling, and basic caching headers so the UI never talks to the DB directly.

tasks.name: Implement core chart primitives
tasks.details: Implement the line/area trend chart and stacked bar chart as reusable components with consistent theming, loading skeletons, empty and error states, accessible labels, and number/date formatting. Each takes a typed data prop contract and is documented in a lightweight component gallery or Storybook. KPI tiles, data tables, and sparklines are handled in the follow-on component task.

tasks.name: Implement shared filters, date-range control, and dashboard state
tasks.details: Create the global filter bar (date range presets plus custom range, plan/segment selector, service selector for log views) and the shared state/URL-sync mechanism so every chart on a page reacts to the same filter selection. Persist selections in the URL so a filtered view can be shared.

tasks.name: Assemble customer analytics dashboard page
tasks.details: Compose the customer-facing dashboard page from the chart library and query API: KPI tiles for active customers and churn, growth trend, revenue trend, and plan/region breakdown tables. Wire all widgets to shared filters and confirm the page matches the metric catalog definitions and the agreed layout mock.

tasks.name: Assemble operational log health dashboard page
tasks.details: Compose the operational dashboard page: error-rate trend with threshold banding, latency percentile chart (p50/p95/p99), request volume, top error codes, and feature usage ranking. Add a drill-down from a spike to the underlying metric rows, and wire the service selector and date range into all widgets.

tasks.name: Add unit, integration, and visual regression tests for the UI
tasks.details: Cover chart components with snapshot/visual regression tests, test filter state and URL sync with integration tests, and mock the query API to assert each dashboard page renders loading, empty, error, and populated states. Add a CI job that fails the build on visual diffs so chart regressions are caught before release.

tasks.name: Set up pipeline orchestration and scheduling
tasks.details: Define the DAG/schedule for CSV ingestion, log processing, and aggregation refresh, including task ordering, retries with backoff, concurrency limits, and dependency on the dashboard's refresh window. Deploy it to the target environment and confirm a full scheduled cycle completes unattended.

tasks.name: Add observability and failure alerting for pipelines and dashboard
tasks.details: Emit structured run metrics and logs from both pipelines, build a small operational view for run status/duration/row counts, and configure alerts for job failure, missed schedule, data-quality threshold breach, and dashboard API latency. Verify each alert fires correctly by simulating the failure condition once.

tasks.name: Run performance and load validation on dashboard and queries
tasks.details: Benchmark the heaviest dashboard queries and endpoints against a realistically sized dataset, measure cold and warm load times, and validate against agreed targets (e.g., page interactive under 3s, API p95 under 500ms). Add indexes or caching where targets are missed, then re-run to confirm.

tasks.name: Complete security and access control review
tasks.details: Review handling of customer PII in CSV ingestion (masking/hashing in logs and non-prod environments), secure secrets and connection strings, enforce authentication and role-based access on dashboard views, and confirm read-only DB credentials for the API. Document findings and remediate any high-severity issues before release.

tasks.name: Write user documentation and operations runbook
tasks.details: Produce a short user guide explaining each dashboard section and metric definition, plus a runbook covering how to re-run a failed job, reprocess a date range, release quarantined CSV files after correction, and rotate credentials. Keep both in the repo alongside the code.

tasks.name: Execute staged rollout and stakeholder sign-off
tasks.details: Roll out to a small pilot user group first, collect feedback for an agreed stabilization window, fix blocking issues, then promote to all users. Hold a final acceptance review against each earlier metric catalog and milestone exit criteria, and record formal stakeholder sign-off with the release notes.

tasks.name: Build KPI tile, table, and sparkline components
tasks.details: Build the KPI tile, sortable data table, and sparkline components with the same theming, accessibility, and state handling as the chart primitives. Extend the component gallery with usage examples and prop documentation, and export a single barrel entry point for the dashboard pages to import from.
